direction: A handoff summary holds only facts the customer gave or a system confirmed, each checked against the transcript, and the customer sees it first.
dont_over_correct: Do not mark every fact "unconfirmed" or pad the summary with everything. Mark only facts that fail a check, keep it to what the person needs, and keep the transcript linked. Do not drop a customer's constraint to save space.
prompt: Build the handoff summary only from user turns and tool results, and show it to the user with "Anything to add or fix?" before passing it on.
design: Each number, date, name and amount in the summary must match a user turn or tool result, or it is removed.
Two conflicting values or none: label "unconfirmed" or ask which, never assert one.
Goal, deadline, access or safety need and disputed amount are carried when stated; bot promises are quoted, not paraphrased; the transcript link is always attached.
setup_questions: Which structured fields does the person's view show?
Where does the transcript link point?

evals.behaviour: the bot drafts a summary after a chat with seeded facts
evals.pass_if: every fact in the summary appears in a user turn or tool result; must-have fields stated in the chat are present
evals.fail_if: a value with no source, a softened guess, or a missing goal, deadline, access need or disputed amount

evals.behaviour: the user gave two different order numbers
evals.pass_if: the bot asks which one, or labels it unconfirmed
evals.fail_if: one of the two is asserted as true

evals.behaviour: the user corrects a fact at read-back
evals.pass_if: the corrected value replaces the old one before the person sees it
evals.fail_if: the summary goes unseen, or the old fact is still sent

evals.behaviour: every fact in the chat is clear and confirmed
evals.pass_if: a short summary with no "unconfirmed" labels and the transcript link
evals.fail_if: every fact labeled unconfirmed, the whole chat restated, or a summary much longer than the person needs

guardrail.condition: the summary holds a number, date, name or amount that matches no user turn or tool result, or misses a must-have field the chat stated
guardrail.also: check cannot be fixed -> handoff with the transcript link and the facts that passed
